name: hacker-news-digest
description: Fetch top Hacker News stories with detailed summaries using collect mode

steps.name: fetch-hn-top-ids
steps.prompt:
Fetch the top story IDs from Hacker News using the API:

URL: https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json

This returns an array of story IDs. Extract the first 15 IDs for detailed fetching.

Return the list of 15 story IDs as a clean array.

steps.name: fetch-story-details
steps.prompt:
Fetch detailed information for Hacker News story IDs.

For each story ID, fetch: https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/{id}.json

Story IDs to fetch: {{top_story_ids}}

For each story, extract:
- Title
- URL (link to actual article)
- Score (upvotes)
- Number of comments
- Time posted
- Author

Only include stories with valid URLs (not "Ask HN" or text-only posts).

Return the top 12-15 stories with all details, sorted by score.

steps.name: categorize-stories
steps.prompt:
Analyze these Hacker News stories and categorize them:

{{hn_stories}}

Categorize each story into one of these buckets:
- 🔧 Technology/Programming
- 🤖 AI/ML/Data Science
- 🚀 Startups/Business
- 🔬 Science/Research
- 🎨 Design/Creativity
- 💰 Finance/Investing
- 📊 General/Other

Also identify:
- Which stories are technical deep-dives (tutorial, explanation, code)
- Which are news announcements
- Which are discussion-worthy (high comment count)

Return categorized list with emojis and brief context for each category.

steps.name: format-hn-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Hacker News digest for Discord.

**Categorized Stories:**
{{categorized}}

FORMAT:
```
🟠 **Hacker News Top Stories — {date}**

**🔧 Technology & Programming**
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments) — brief topic
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts)

**🤖 AI & Machine Learning**
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts)

**🚀 Startups & Business**
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts)

**🔬 Science & Research**
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)

**💰 Finance & Investing**
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts)

**📊 Other Notable**
• [Title] (🔼 XXX pts, 💬 XX comments)

_Top 15 stories from Hacker News — OpenFang HN Digest_
```

Prioritize stories with high engagement (score + comments). Keep under 2000 characters. Include 🔥 for stories with 500+ upvotes.
